source_title: Development and validation of a framework and scale for K–12 teacher–AI collaborative teaching competence
title_zh: K–12 教師與 AI 協作教學能力的框架與量表發展及驗證
source_locator: 出版社文章頁（link.springer.com，2026-11-08 讀取 200）：Published 07 November 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 4 至 9 句
original_excerpt: To address this gap, this study develops and validates a dedicated framework and measurement instrument for K–12 Teacher–AI Collaborative Teaching Competence (TAICT-C). … A two-phase sequential mixed-methods design was adopted. … In Phase 1, a three-round Delphi study involving 24 educational technology experts was conducted to develop and refine the TAICT-C framework. … The framework comprised four dimensions: collaborative mindset, precision design, joint teaching, and continuous development. … In Phase 2, a corresponding scale (TAICT-CS) was developed and validated using standardized procedures. … An initial pool of 65 items was generated from the framework, reviewed for content validity, and subsequently administered to 755 K–12 teachers across 23 provinces in China.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究目的、兩階段設計、框架向度與樣本；因素結構與信效度數值依規則不寫入。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Educational Technology Research and Development，監測清單 J07）；量表施測對象為中國 23 個省份的 K–12 教師 755 人，框架建構階段另有教育科技專家 24 人；摘要未寫教師是否皆為在職。

ai_lit_note: K–12 教師與 AI 協作教學的能力框架與量表，屬教師 AI 素養（A），對應 T-TEA「促進教師與AI教學協作的正向循環」、T-PD「評估教師AI素養以規劃專業增能」
summary_evidence_spans: To address this gap, this study develops and validates a dedicated framework and measurement instrument for K–12 Teacher–AI Collaborative Teaching Competence (TAICT-C).
A two-phase sequential mixed-methods design was adopted.
In Phase 1, a three-round Delphi study involving 24 educational technology experts was conducted to develop and refine the TAICT-C framework.
The framework comprised four dimensions: collaborative mindset, precision design, joint teaching, and continuous development.
In Phase 2, a corresponding scale (TAICT-CS) was developed and validated using standardized procedures.
An initial pool of 65 items was generated from the framework, reviewed for content validity, and subsequently administered to 755 K–12 teachers across 23 provinces in China.
attributed_summary: 研究發展並驗證 K–12 教師與 AI 協作教學能力（TAICT-C）的框架與測量工具，採兩階段循序混合方法；第一階段由 24 名教育科技專家進行三輪德懷術，框架含協作心態、精準設計、共同教學與持續發展四個向度；第二階段依框架編擬 65 題初始題庫，經內容效度審查後施測於中國 23 個省份的 755 名 K–12 教師。

claim_text: 來源機構：Journal of Educational Computing Research（SAGE）；資料標題：Developing and Validating an AI-Literacy-Integrated Teaching Acceptance and Readiness Scale for Mathematics Teachers；來源刊登日：2026-11-05。作者摘要報告：研究發展並驗證數學教師 AI 素養融入教學接受度與準備度量表（AILTAR-M）；量表分兩個領域：接受度含改編自科技接受模式的知覺有用性、知覺易用性、使用態度與行為意圖，準備度含自陳的知覺 AI 素養與教學自我效能；以中國 549 名數學教師進行心理計量評估。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Developing and Validating an AI-Literacy-Integrated Teaching Acceptance and Readiness Scale for Mathematics Teachers
title_zh: 數學教師 AI 素養融入教學接受度與準備度量表之發展與驗證
source_locator: 首發日依 Crossref published-online（出版社頁讀取失敗：SAGE 回 Cloudflare 驗證頁；出版者 PDF 只印 2026, Vol. 0(0)）：2026-11-05；摘要歸屬：出版者 PDF（管理者 2026-11-08 提供）Abstract 第 3、4、5 句
original_excerpt: In response, this study developed and validated the AI-Literacy-Integrated Teaching Acceptance and Readiness Scale for Mathematics Teachers (AILTAR-M). … The instrument was theoretically organized around two domains: (1) Acceptance, comprising four constructs adapted from the Technology Acceptance Model (Perceived Usefulness, Perceived Ease of Use, Attitude toward Use, and Behavioral Intention); and (2) Readiness, encompassing Perceived AI Literacy as a self-reported cognitive dimension and Teaching Self-Efficacy as a motivational dimension. … Psychometric evaluation with 549 mathematics teachers in China supported a 29-item, six-factor structure.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的量表目的、兩個領域與構念、樣本；因素結構、解釋變異量與信效度數值不寫入。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Journal of Educational Computing Research，監測清單 J36）；中國線上便利抽樣的數學教師 549 人，其中在職 423 人（以國中、高中為主，小學約 3.8%）、職前 126 人，依多數判為中小學在職教師；作者之一為該刊編委，文中聲明未參與審稿。
ai_crosscheck_record: 第一輪 2026-11-07 子代理以監測期刊 ISSN 查詢列出（SAGE 頁 Cloudflare，Crossref published-online 2026-11-05，摘要未寫學段），列入瀏覽器清單；管理者 2026-11-08 提供出版者 PDF，本 session 讀 Participants and Procedure 核對在職 423 人（以國中、高中為主）、職前 126 人，擇摘要第 3、4、5 句撰寫中文摘要與中文譯名，不寫因素結構與信效度數值；PDF 未印上線日，首發日採 Crossref published-online；第二輪 2026-11-08 由隔離子代理逐句對照全文，判定通過。同一模型，非獨立審閱。
ai_lit_note: 數學教師把 AI 素養納入教學目標的接受度與準備度量表，屬教師 AI 素養（A），對應 T-TEA「評估AI與教學法整合的適切性」、T-PD「評估教師AI素養以規劃專業增能」
summary_evidence_spans: In response, this study developed and validated the AI-Literacy-Integrated Teaching Acceptance and Readiness Scale for Mathematics Teachers (AILTAR-M).

The instrument was theoretically organized around two domains: (1) Acceptance, comprising four constructs adapted from the Technology Acceptance Model (Perceived Usefulness, Perceived Ease of Use, Attitude toward Use, and Behavioral Intention); and (2) Readiness, encompassing Perceived AI Literacy as a self-reported cognitive dimension and Teaching Self-Efficacy as a motivational dimension.
Psychometric evaluation with 549 mathematics teachers in China supported a 29-item, six-factor structure.
attributed_summary: 研究發展並驗證數學教師 AI 素養融入教學接受度與準備度量表（AILTAR-M）；量表分兩個領域：接受度含改編自科技接受模式的知覺有用性、知覺易用性、使用態度與行為意圖，準備度含自陳的知覺 AI 素養與教學自我效能；以中國 549 名數學教師進行心理計量評估。

title_zh: 以生成式 AI 支援的 vibe coding 增能 K-12 教師開發教育軟體

original_excerpt: This mixed-method study analyzed vibe coding prompt logs and development notes from 12 K-12 Korean teachers over a three-week period to explore what they created, how they navigated the development process, and what opportunities and challenges they experienced. … Results showed that vibe coding enabled teachers to create deployable tools primarily for instructional and administrative purposes.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的設計、樣本、研究問題與作者描述的產出用途；提示意圖序列分析與作者對分層效益的推論不寫入。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Journal of Research on Technology in Education，監測清單 J08）；南韓在職中小學教師 12 人（小學 9、國中 2、高中 1）、三週的研究；作者寫明為探索性研究、主要依描述性證據，不支持強的因果主張。
ai_crosscheck_record: 第一輪 2026-11-07 子代理以監測期刊 ISSN 查詢列出（T&F 頁 Cloudflare，Crossref 無摘要），列入瀏覽器清單；管理者 2026-11-08 提供出版者 PDF，本 session 讀 PDF 核對 Published online 06 Nov 2026 與 Participants and procedure（南韓在職中小學教師 12 人），擇摘要第 3、4 句撰寫中文摘要與中文譯名；第二輪 2026-11-08 由隔離子代理逐句對照全文，判定需修改，依建議範圍說明改寫作者自述的探索性與描述性證據（刪去全文未寫的「無對照組」），修正後一致；分類維持 B，審查者提示可討論 A（邊界案例，已告知管理者）。同一模型，非獨立審閱。
ai_lit_note: 中小學教師以生成式 AI 支援的 vibe coding 自行開發教學與行政工具，研究重點為工具使用歷程，屬 AI 賦能教學（B），對應 T-TEA「客製AI教學工具與資源」
summary_evidence_spans: This mixed-method study analyzed vibe coding prompt logs and development notes from 12 K-12 Korean teachers over a three-week period to explore what they created, how they navigated the development process, and what opportunities and challenges they experienced.
Results showed that vibe coding enabled teachers to create deployable tools primarily for instructional and administrative purposes.
attributed_summary: 這項混合方法研究分析 12 名韓國 K-12 教師三週間的 vibe coding 提示紀錄與開發筆記，探討他們做出什麼、如何進行開發，以及經歷哪些機會與挑戰；作者報告教師以 vibe coding 做出可部署的工具，主要用於教學與行政用途。

claim_text: 來源機構：Behavioral Sciences (MDPI)；資料標題：Adolescents’ Motivation for AI-Enabled Environmental Actions: The Role of Supportive Environments and Expectancy–Value Theory；來源刊登日：2026-11-05。作者摘要報告：研究以情境期望價值理論為基礎，採問卷調查與共變異數結構方程模型，檢視支持性社會規範、促進條件、期望、任務價值與知覺成本，和青少年使用 AI 參與環保活動的動機之間的關係；共收回 602 份有效問卷，並以探索性與驗證性因素分析檢驗測量結構。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Adolescents’ Motivation for AI-Enabled Environmental Actions: The Role of Supportive Environments and Expectancy–Value Theory
title_zh: 青少年運用 AI 參與環保行動的動機：支持性環境與期望價值理論的角色
source_locator: 出版者 PDF（MDPI 對程式回 403；管理者 2026-11-08 提供）：Published 5 November 2026（與 Crossref published-online 一致）；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 3、4 句
original_excerpt: Based on Situated Expectancy–Value Theory (SEVT), in this study, a questionnaire survey and covariance-based structural equation modeling (CB-SEM) were employed to examine the relationships between supportive social norms, facilitating conditions, expectancy, task value, and perceived cost and adolescents’ motivation to use AI to participate in environmental protection activities. … A total of 602 valid questionnaires were collected, and the measurement structure was examined through exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的理論、設計、變項與樣本數；各變項與動機的相關及路徑結果屬相關研究，不寫入，引用時不得寫成因果。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（Behavioral Sciences，監測清單 J52）；中國華東、華南 11 所小學、國中與高中的學生 602 人（10–18 歲）橫斷面自陳問卷，相關研究；作者寫明樣本學校具環境教育基礎、測的是使用動機而非實際使用行為；另有 30 名青少年與 30 名成人的探索性追蹤調查，作者寫明不足以建立年齡差異的解釋機制。
ai_crosscheck_record: 第一輪 2026-11-06 子代理以監測期刊 ISSN 查詢列出（MDPI 403，摘要未寫學校或年齡），列入瀏覽器清單；管理者 2026-11-08 提供出版者 PDF，本 session 讀 3.2 節與表 1 核對 11 所小學至高中、10–18 歲學生 602 人，擇摘要第 3、4 句撰寫中文摘要與中文譯名，不寫相關與路徑結果；第二輪 2026-11-08 由隔離子代理逐句對照全文，判定通過，依建議範圍說明補作者所述樣本學校與測量限制；分類維持 B，審查者提示可討論 A（邊界案例，已告知管理者）。同一模型，非獨立審閱。
ai_lit_note: 中小學生使用 AI 參與環保活動的動機與其情境支持，研究重點為 AI 工具的使用動機，屬 AI 賦能學習（B），對應 S-LRN「認知AI可優化學習而提升動機」
summary_evidence_spans: Based on Situated Expectancy–Value Theory (SEVT), in this study, a questionnaire survey and covariance-based structural equation modeling (CB-SEM) were employed to examine the relationships between supportive social norms, facilitating conditions, expectancy, task value, and perceived cost and adolescents’ motivation to use AI to participate in environmental protection activities.
A total of 602 valid questionnaires were collected, and the measurement structure was examined through exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis.
attributed_summary: 研究以情境期望價值理論為基礎，採問卷調查與共變異數結構方程模型，檢視支持性社會規範、促進條件、期望、任務價值與知覺成本，和青少年使用 AI 參與環保活動的動機之間的關係；共收回 602 份有效問卷，並以探索性與驗證性因素分析檢驗測量結構。
